%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Time periods.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Train services.
%@ index R ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Rolling stock.

%@ var x shape=S,T domain=binary role=primary drole=service_cancellation lo=- hi=- :: Service cancellation indicator.
%@ var y shape=R,T domain=binary role=primary drole=rolling_stock_reassignment lo=- hi=- :: Rolling stock reassignment indicator.
%@ var z shape=S,T domain=binary role=primary drole=additional_service lo=- hi=- :: Additional train service insertion indicator.
%@ var w shape=S,T domain=non_negative role=auxiliary drole=delay lo=0 hi=- :: Delay at each service and period.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_cost combination=sum :: Minimize total delay, operational costs, penalties for cancellations, and costs related to slot planning.
%@ con service_continuity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure service continuity.
%@ con fleet_feasibility kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure fleet feasibility.
%@ con delay_limit kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Limit delay at each service and period.

%@ con slot_limit kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Limit additional train service slots.

  & w_{s,t} \ge t_{s,t} - t_{s,t-1} \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{service\_continuity} \\
  & \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}} y_{r,t} \le \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} (1 - x_{s,t}) \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{fleet\_feasibility} \\
  & w_{s,t} \le M \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{delay\_limit} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} x_{s,t} \le 1 \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{cancellation\_limit} \\
  & \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} z_{s,t} \le 1 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{slot\_limit} \\
  & t_{s,t} \ge d_t \cdot (1 - x_{s,t}) \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{disruption\_duration} \\
